text:
mike: Quick flag  runtime/quickstart has a broken screenshot (image 403) on staging. Happened after the recent CDN rekey. The image path is /assets/quickstart/serve-diagram.png. Anyone own that asset?

anne: Can you paste the page + image url so I can repro?

mike: Page: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart
Image src: https://cdn.internal.redwood.ai/assets/quickstart/serve-diagram.png (403)

doc-bot: linkcheck: asset 403 detected for /assets/quickstart/serve-diagram.png referenced by /runtime/quickstart. First seen 2026-02-28.

terry: Docs infra owns CDN mapping. I can rehost under docs static bucket if CDN key is messed up. Quick question: is there a localized version referencing same path?

mike: Yes, pt and ja pages include the same relative path. l10n-bot might have backported the page.

l10n-bot: localization: noted references in /pt/runtime/quickstart and /ja/runtime/quickstart. Ticket L10N-412 open for backport checks.

anne: Small plan: 1) rehost the file to docs/static/quickstart/serve-diagram.png, 2) update pages to use relative include /static/quickstart/serve-diagram.png, 3) add a quick smoke curl to ensure 200.

terry: I can do the rehost + PR. If we keep the same filename under /static it avoids changing markdown elsewhere if we update redirect rules. But prefer to update pages to use /static path explicitly so callers don't depend on CDN mapping.

mike: SGTM. Any suggested sed to patch markdown for all locales?

anne: Example sed to replace the image src across files in the repo (run from repo root):

```bash
# replace CDN path with internal static include
git grep -l "/assets/quickstart/serve-diagram.png" | xargs -n1 sed -i "s@/assets/quickstart/serve-diagram.png@/static/quickstart/serve-diagram.png@g"
```

# quick smoke: ensure final URL returns 200
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/static/quickstart/serve-diagram.png"

terry: I'll upload the image to docs/static/quickstart/ and open PR with the sed change + tiny smoke test under docs-smoke/quickchecks. Assigning to myself, requesting anne for review and @docs-ci for the test.

mike: One more ask: please add a short KB note under /kb/assets-rehosting with reason (CDN rekey) and locales to backport. l10n-bot will queue translations.

l10n-bot: noted. Will queue backport tasks for pt and ja once PR merges.

docs-ci: cheap smoke is fine. We'll run the curl only when docs/static/quickstart or runtime/quickstart.md changes. Tag @docs-ci in the PR description to trigger CI config review.

terry: PR opened: #5012-rehost-serve-diagram-static + smoke. Includes: add static asset, replace references in en/pt/ja pages, add curl smoke test. Requesting review anne, mike; cc docs-ci and l10n-bot.

anne: LGTM. One tiny nit in the PR: please include the original CDN URL in the PR body for audit.

mike: Thanks! I'll add the KB entry and follow up after merge.

doc-bot: notice logged: docs.asset_change by terry. ID: ac-20260228-3

terry: Merging shortly once smoke passes. Thanks team.
